# JM Construction Ltd Blog

> > Expert construction and renovation guidance for UK homeowners covering planning permission, building regulations, and home improvement projects in London and beyond.

JM Construction Ltd's blog provides comprehensive guides on UK construction projects, from new builds to conversions and extensions. Content focuses on navigating UK Building Regulations 2010, Permitted Development Rights, planning permission requirements, and cost considerations for residential construction and renovation projects.

## Key Topics

- UK Building Regulations 2010
- Permitted Development Rights (PDRs)
- Planning Permission
- Party Wall Act
- Building Regulations Approval
- Part M Building Regulations
- Planning Portal
- Competent Person Scheme
- Party Wall Surveyors
- Home Extensions
- Loft Conversions
- Renovation Costs & Budgeting
- London Construction
- Property Value Enhancement
- Areas of Outstanding Natural Beauty

## Planning Permission & Building Regulations

- [Building Regulations Approval in the UK: Your Complete Guide](https://blog.jmconstructionltd.co.uk/building-regulations-approval-in-the-uk-your-complete-guide): Complete guide to UK Building Regulations 2010 approval and compliance
- [What Can You Build on Land Without Planning Permission?](https://blog.jmconstructionltd.co.uk/what-can-you-build-on-land-without-planning-permission): UK Permitted Development Rights guide via Planning Portal resources
- [What Is Retrospective Planning Permission and How Does It Work?](https://blog.jmconstructionltd.co.uk/what-is-retrospective-planning-permission-and-how-does-it-work): UK retrospective planning permission guide for property modifications
- [Understanding the Implications of the Party Wall Act](https://blog.jmconstructionltd.co.uk/understanding-the-party-wall-act): UK Party Wall Act guide with surveyors and dispute resolution info
- [Understanding Part M Building Regulations](https://blog.jmconstructionltd.co.uk/understanding-part-m-building-regulations): Part M Building Regulations accessibility compliance guide for UK projects
- [Loft Conversion Planning Permission: What You Need to Know](https://blog.jmconstructionltd.co.uk/loft-conversion-planning-permission-what-you-need-to-know): UK loft conversion planning permission and permitted development rights guide
